title: OpenWiki: a CLI that generates your repo wiki and keeps it current via daily GitHub Action PR
description:
Agent docs usually rot because code changes faster than anyone updates the wiki. OpenWiki is a CLI that writes that documentation once, then keeps it current. Point it at your repo and it generates a wiki, then a daily GitHub Action opens a PR to refresh it as the code changes. It drops prompting into your AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md automatically, so your agent knows to check it first.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/langchain-ai/openwiki
